gather.online_mode.on.tooltip: Players need a Microsoft account to join.
gather.online_mode.off.tooltip: Anyone on your network can join under any name, even without a Microsoft account. Only turn this off if you trust everyone who can reach your world, or turn on the whitelist.
gather.server_name.tooltip: The name your friends see in their LAN server list. Use & codes for colors and styles, like &6 for gold or &l for bold. Leave it empty for the default.
gather.whitelist.tooltip: Only players on the whitelist can join. Add them with /whitelist add <name>, which needs commands to be allowed.
gather.idle_timeout.tooltip: Kicks players who haven't moved for this long. You are never kicked from your own world.
gather.open_on_load.tooltip: Opens this world to LAN with the same settings every time you load it.
gather.published: Your world is open to LAN. Friends on your network can join at %s
gather.disconnect.host_name: That name belongs to the host of this world.
gather.commands.ban.owner: Cannot ban server owner in LAN game
